cost_boundary: Retain every original and extension allocation, including failed starts. Only coefficient varies; updates/prompts are matched, not GPU time or response tokens.
reference_controls: all four paired offline_sft, oracle_sft and initial from anchor-development-v1
resource_authorization: 2026-10-28 user removed global 8-GPU limit; original frozen protocol bytes retained
selection_rule: Wait for all three weights and both controls at all four seeds. Among weights passing the original advance rule, choose greatest mean DEV business macro; exact ties use smaller anchor weight. Pure AOPD is an ablation only. No holdout may be viewed until one candidate and confirmation protocol are frozen.
